info.title: LANywhere
info.author: augustocco
info.description: Your local multiplayer, online. No PC, no setup.
info.details:
LANywhere takes the local wireless mode of your games to the internet: local multiplayer, but your friends don't have to be in the room.

Create a group in a game's local wireless mode as usual and players anywhere in the world can join it; search for groups and you'll see the ones open online. There's also a private room with a 6-letter code to play only with a friend.

- No PC, no client to run, no IPs to type: a public server is already running.
- Other players see a nickname, never your console user name, and never your IP.
- Open the LANywhere app to see the open groups, pick one and open its game.
- Spanish and English.
- A PC with the Ryujinx emulator (LAN Play mode) can join the same groups as consoles.

NOTE: LANywhere is based on ldn_mitm and replaces it (both use the same sysmodule). Don't install ldn_mitm at the same time. Restart the console after installing.

Requires Atmosphere 1.12.x. This is a beta: if you try it, tell us how it went on GitHub.

changelog:
0.2.0
Ryujinx (LAN Play mode) can play in the same groups as consoles. Full matches: large game packets now get through. More robust with bursts of packets. Consoles on 0.1.0 must update to join new groups.

0.1.0
First beta release.
